entities.name: CDCP1
observations: CUB domain-containing protein 1 (CDCP1; also called SIMA) is distinct from CUBN/cubilin. PMID:27495374 reports CDCP1 and EGFR cooperation in breast cancer cell detachment and adherens-junction disruption.

In MDA-MB-468 cells, CDCP1 expression promoted detachment and suspension growth; phosphorylation-site mutant Y734F did not support suspension growth similarly. The study reports a CDCP1–Src–EGFR complex and Src-dependent EGFR transactivation. Results were cell-context dependent.

source_tools.relevance: Exact-name primary study on CDCP1 and EGFR cooperation in cell detachment

entities.name: PMID:27495374
observations: Primary 2016 report titled “CUB domain-containing protein 1 and the epidermal growth factor receptor cooperate to induce cell detachment.” In breast cancer models, CDCP1 and EGFR cooperated in detachment and adherens-junction disruption; reported mechanism involved CDCP1–Src–EGFR signaling.
Retrieved evidence identifies MDA-MB-468 cells and CDCP1 Y734F mutant; response was not universal across tested cell backgrounds.
